description: Concatenate two strings. Missing or null inputs use empty text, so the result is the available value or an empty string when both inputs are absent.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: First text to concatenate. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: Second text to concatenate. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the two inputs joined in order, or empty text when both inputs are absent.

description: Convert text to uppercase. Missing or null input returns an empty string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to convert to uppercase. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the uppercase text, or empty text when the input is absent.

description: Convert text to lowercase. Missing or null input returns an empty string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to convert to lowercase. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the lowercase text, or empty text when the input is absent.

description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from text. Missing or null input returns an empty string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text whose leading and trailing whitespace should be removed. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the trimmed text, or empty text when the input is absent.

description: Return the number of characters in text. Missing or null input returns zero.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text whose character count should be returned. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the number of characters, or zero when the input is absent.

description: Check whether text has no characters. Missing or null input is treated as empty and returns true.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to check. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: is_empty
outputs.description: Returns true when the text has no characters, including when the input is missing or null.

description: Check whether text is empty or contains only whitespace. Missing or null input is treated as blank and returns true.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to check. Missing or null input is treated as blank text.

outputs.name: is_blank
outputs.description: Returns true when the text is empty or whitespace-only, including when the input is missing or null.

description: Check whether text is a signed integer or decimal number. Missing, empty, blank, or malformed text returns false.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to check for a signed integer or decimal number. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: is_numeric
outputs.description: Returns true for a signed integer or decimal number and false for missing, empty, blank, or malformed text.
